_comment: DP-Score stage ladder over (Karte, DP): anchor tier (mined live or dynamic
section anchor with hasPosition=false) -> intra-section distance -> battle-
zone SectionGraph hop distance (claim beats no claim; '-' = no recorded
route = NO claim, never 'far') -> friend leash (Vollrecht) -> DP diversity
-> legacy seed chain. RELATION vectors are hand-pilled; absolute winners
whose tie falls to the SEED CHAIN (dyn green-vs-green, all-used) were
produced by --record once and reviewed. null_law pins: with NO fact at all
the scored path lands bit-identically on the legacy XOR OrderBy line.
Rows are DpRow.Dump() in candidate input order.

score_cases.name: player33_fluchtzone_dyn_anchor
score_cases._why: Player-33 §3 reproduction: mined anchor died by the M14d phase law (absent here), the mission ACTIVATED the flight zone (dynamic section anchor), own groups sit at the start. Choice must land on a Green DP in the activated zone - never the Red cluster.

expect._review: winner from dp_score_record.json (record-reviewed 08.11): the two Green DPs tie by law (tier 0, sec-anchor, zone 0) and the legacy seed chain breaks the tie deterministically.

score_cases.name: dyn_anchor_position_preserved
score_cases._why: Section carries BOTH a dynamic section anchor and a positioned anchor: the positioned anchor keeps the intra-section precision (measured first); the whole-section claim never erases real coordinates.

score_cases.name: dyn_anchor_no_position_leak
score_cases._why: Section-only anchor: candidate COORDINATES must not leak into the tier - both rows read anchor=sec although the DPs sit 9 units apart. Green tie falls to the seed chain (recorded winner).

expect._review: winner record-reviewed 08.11 (pure seed chain over the sec-anchor tie).

score_cases.name: zone_claim_beats_none
score_cases._why: Stage 3, Loch-Gesetz: a recorded route (zone=1) beats no recorded route (zone=-). Absence of knowledge is no claim and no penalty: the claimless DP simply cannot win this stage.

score_cases.name: zone_farness_ranked
score_cases._why: Stage 3 among known distances: nearest battle-zone hop wins (a DP INSIDE the zone section reads zone=0).

score_cases.name: zone_equal_leash_decides
score_cases._why: Equal zone distance -> stage 4: the friendly leash as Vollrecht (no anchor needed anymore - this is the P33-H4 upgrade over the M14e tie-only law).

score_cases.name: zone_beats_leash
score_cases._why: The leash can never out-rank a spatial claim: stage 3 decides BEFORE stage 4 (canon M14e law preserved: leash is last-but-two, never first).

score_cases.name: diversity_beats_seed
score_cases._why: Stage 5: DP-DIVERSITAET - an unused point beats the seed chain (Green-1-Klumpen law); it never overrules a spatial or leash claim (see next case).

score_cases.name: leash_beats_fresh
score_cases._why: Stage order proof: leash (4) decides BEFORE diversity (5) - concentration at the friendly section wins over a fresh point elsewhere.

score_cases.name: all_used_diversity_inert
score_cases._why: Diversity never walls the choice: when EVERY point is recorded as used, all candidates are stale, the stage is inert and the legacy seed chain decides (recorded winner).

expect._review: winner record-reviewed 08.11 (pure seed chain; the diversity stage is inert when nothing is fresh).

score_cases.name: tier_beats_zone_claim
score_cases._why: Anker tier keeps absolute Primat (canon law): a DP in the anchor section wins over a battle-zone-nearer DP outside it, even with a bigger measured hop distance.

null_law.name: p34_r5_leash_beats_fresh
null_law._why: Player-34 r5 Diagnose (DG049 ging an das own=1 recycled Green 3 (anchor=4) statt an das freie frische Green 5 (anchor=0)): BEIDE tier=0, aber Green 5s anchor=0 liegt in einer ANDEREN Sektion - innere Distanz ist nie eine Abschnittsuebergreifende Behauptung (Loch-Gesetz, dieselbe Stufe wie im Comparator); Kampfzone unbekannt = null claim; dann entscheidet die Freund-Leine (own=1) VOR fresh. Das ist exakt die geschriebene Gesetztesliste ('DP diversity ... never out-ranks a spatial or leash claim'), kein Umdeuten - der Uebergang wird hier auf die geschriebene Ordnung festgenagelt.

null_law.name: p34_r3_sec_anchor_does_not_outrank_leash
null_law._why: Player-34 r3 (E-Web ging an own=1 recycled Green 3 (anchor=4) statt an die freie frische Green 4 (anchor=sec)): ein Sektions-Anker ist eine GANZSEKTIONS-Behauptung - tiergleich mit dem positionierten Anker, keine Positions-Fakten zum Vorziehen; Kampfzone gleich; die Leine entscheidet vor fresh. Beide Beziehungen in einem Pin: tier-Gleichheit sec-vs-pos-Anker UND leash > fresh.

null_law.name: fresh_beats_recycled_when_prior_equal
null_law._why: Der fresh-Hebel selbst, positiv gepinnt: tier, Sektionsdistanz (gleicher Anker, gleiche Distanz), Kampfzone und Leine ALLE gleich => Stufe 5 (DP-DIVERSITAET) wirkt: fresh schlaegt recycled. Genau das, was die Gesetztesliste hergibt (Stufe 5 erreicht nur, wer bei allen frueheren Stufen gleich las) - nicht mehr und nicht weniger.

null_law.name: p34_r1_all_equal_seed
null_law._why: Player-34 r1 (Sturmtruppen/Gestaltwandler/Ordnungssoldaten auf Green 1): die Prämisse 'Green 2 fresh=1' haelt dem Log NICHT stand - zum Waehlzeitpunkt waren BEIDE DP own=1 UND fresh=0 (Green 2 wurde schon vom 2. DP der Runde genommen, dp-score all-Liste der Sturmtruppen-Zeile zeigt fresh=0 bei beiden). Alle Faktenstufen gleich => die SEED-Kette entscheidet; ihr absoluter Winner wird nie von Hand gerechnet (Record-Diziplin) - winner_in pinnt die Menge, decided=stage pinnt die Kette.
